titles.native: ふくびき！トライアングル～美晴アフター～

description:
Based on the erotic game by Blue Gale.

Miharu is Ushio-kuns girlfriend for some time now and is pretty open-minded about sex, but then an accident happens and she loses all memories and reverts back to her shy self. Can Ushio get back her memories? Or will Miharu's sister dominate him?
